playlist.playlist_title: Celebrating the 20th Anniversary of Renovation of the Heart
playlist.playlist_description:
April 2022 marks the 20th anniversary of the publication of Dallas Willard's Renovation of the Heart. The Willard Family, Dallas Willard Ministries, NavPress and SPCK Publishers are celebrating this milestone with the release of a new edition of Renovation of the Heart. We’ve also invited 20 Christian leaders from around the world to share their reflections on how this incredible book has impacted their lives and the Church at large over the past 20 years. Be watching for a new video in this series to be posted every Monday for 20 weeks.

Celebrate Renovation of the Heart with us! 
Visit our website to learn more about this life-changing book that was written to encourage and spur us on in our daily discipleship and ongoing journey towards Christlikeness: https://dwillard.org/books/renovation-of-the-heart
On this page you will find:
1. A complete description of what Renovation of the Heart is all about. 
2. Links to purchase your own copy in your preferred format and language.
3. Links to FREE resources that will help you study the book on your own or with friends (including the Renovaré Book Club beginning March 28).
4. Links to other books that will help you practice what you learn.

Visit the Renovare website to hear a podcast about Jan Johnson's work with Dallas, this book, and get some good advice about ways we can apply the Renovation of the Heart material in our own lives:  
https://renovare.org/podcast/jan-johnson-practicing-renovation
